assumptions: The rows are a real alignment: equal length, homologous column for column.
hmmbuild’s default build path: symfrac column assignment, PB weighting, entropy-weighted effective count, mixture Dirichlet priors.
limits: Above 50,000 rows hmmbuild switches to subsampled weights; that path is refused, not approximated.
Calibration simulates random sequences: a different seed gives slightly different statistics, as in hmmbuild.
bio.jane/contract.question: What profile HMM does hmmbuild make of this alignment, and with what E-value statistics?

description: Build a profile HMM from aligned sequences on this machine, as HMMER 3.4's hmmbuild builds one: columns whose weighted residue fraction clears `symfrac` become match states, rows are Henikoff position-based weighted so near-duplicates do not outvote a divergent member, the counts are entropy-weighted down to a target information per position, and the model is calibrated for E-values by hmmbuild's own simulation.

EfL.description: hmmbuild --EfL: their length, in residues. Only applies when calibrate is true. Advanced.

EfN.description: hmmbuild --EfN: random sequences the Forward fit is made over. Only applies when calibrate is true. Advanced.

Eft.description: hmmbuild --Eft: the tail mass the Forward exponential is fitted to. Only applies when calibrate is true. Advanced.

EmL.description: hmmbuild --EmL: their length, in residues. Only applies when calibrate is true. Advanced.

EmN.description: hmmbuild --EmN: random sequences the MSV fit is made over. Only applies when calibrate is true. Advanced.

EvL.description: hmmbuild --EvL: their length, in residues. Only applies when calibrate is true. Advanced.

EvN.description: hmmbuild --EvN: random sequences the Viterbi fit is made over. Only applies when calibrate is true. Advanced.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

alignment.description: the aligned rows as `{ name, aligned }`, gaps included: wire align_sequences’ `alignedSequences` here. Rows of different lengths are refused as unaligned.

alignment_file.description: or an alignment file, by name, from the project or the `_files` sent with the call: Stockholm, Clustal, PHYLIP, MSF or aligned FASTA, read by the same reader the alignment tab opens it with.

alphabet.description: `auto` reads the rows the way Easel does. Set it when a short alignment is read wrongly. Values: auto (Auto (Easel’s rule)), amino (Protein), DNA (DNA), RNA (RNA). Advanced.

calibrate.description: fit E-value statistics by simulation, as hmmbuild does. Off, the model has bit scores and no E-values, and hmmscan refuses it.

effn.description: `entropy` scales the counts until the model carries `ere` bits per position, which makes it a family model rather than a memory of this alignment; `none` uses the rows as counted; `set` uses `eset`. Values: entropy (Entropy-weighted), none (Actual count), set (Fixed (eset)).

ere.description: hmmbuild --ere: the target mean relative entropy in bits per position. 0 takes hmmbuild’s alphabet default (0.59 protein, 0.62 nucleic). Only applies when effn is entropy.

eset.description: hmmbuild --eset: the effective sequence count to use. Only applies when effn is set.

esigma.description: hmmbuild --esigma: the entropy target’s small-model correction. 0 takes hmmbuild’s default. Only applies when effn is entropy. Advanced.

fragthresh.description: hmmbuild --fragthresh: a row spanning less than this fraction of the alignment is a fragment, and its leading and trailing gaps are read as missing data rather than deletions.

name.description: the model’s name, written on its NAME line.

seed.description: hmmbuild --seed: the simulation is reproducible, and the same seed gives the same statistics. Only applies when calibrate is true.

symfrac.description: hmmbuild --symfrac: a column becomes a match state when this weighted fraction of rows carry a residue there rather than a gap.

weighting.description: `pb` is Henikoff position-based weighting (hmmbuild’s default), so twenty near-identical rows do not outvote one divergent member; `none` counts every row once. Values: pb (Position-based (Henikoff)), none (Equal).

name: hmm_build

fragments.description: rows the fragment rule treated as partial sequences

hmm.description: the model as HMMER3/f text: wire it into hmm_search’s `profile_text`, or keep it as a `.hmm`

matchColumns.description: the alignment columns that became match states, 1-based

meanRelativeEntropy.description: mean relative entropy per match state, in bits (hmmbuild’s re/pos)

profile.description: the model built: name, match states, alphabet, effective sequence count, whether it carries E-value statistics

stats.description: the fitted MSV, Viterbi and Forward mu and lambda; absent when calibration was off

weights.description: each row’s relative weight, in input order
